key_insight: VEFX-Bench provides a first-of-its-kind, large-scale benchmark that pairs raw videos, instruction-guided editing tasks, professionally produced edited outputs, and human quality labels with a standardized evaluator—enabling fair, reproducible comparison of generic video editing and VFX systems.
problem_solved: Addresses the absence of a comprehensive, human-annotated dataset and a standardized evaluation protocol for instruction-guided video editing and visual effects, overcoming small-scale resources, missing edited outputs, and lack of human quality labels.
method: Assembled a large-scale dataset of raw videos linked to instruction-guided editing tasks and high-quality edited ground-truth outputs (before/after pairs).
Collected human quality labels and diverse editing examples across generic editing and VFX categories using a standardized annotation protocol.
Built a benchmark evaluator combining quantitative metrics, human-in-the-loop judgments, and baseline model evaluations to produce reproducible rankings and a public leaderboard.
impact: Enables AI/ML practitioners to fairly compare and iterate on video-editing and VFX models with human-aligned evaluation, accelerating development of practical, production-ready editing systems and reproducible research.
visual_elements: Side-by-side 'Before / After' video thumbnails demonstrating typical edits and VFX transformations.

Evaluation pipeline diagram illustrating input video + instruction → model → edited output → automated metrics + human raters → leaderboard.
Benchmark leaderboard/chart comparing baseline methods across key metrics (quality, fidelity, instruction-following).
paper_title: VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects
paper_authors: Xiangbo Gao, Sicong Jiang, Bangya Liu, Xinghao Chen, Minglai Yang
